text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin got injured,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I can hear you just fine without you yelling like that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
An injury like this is nothing!
The pain is already fading, so I'm totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I can handle training without any problem too, so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-What!?
choice_data_list: I came to the infirmary because it looked like something might be wrong.
I came to the infirmary because it looked like something might be wrong.
I'll live up to your enthusiasm!
I'll live up to your enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-What!?
choice_data_list: I came to the infirmary because it looked like something might be wrong.
I came to the infirmary because it looked like something might be wrong.
I'll live up to your enthusiasm!
I'll live up to your enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I don't have time to rest!
You of all people should understand that, shouldn't you!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If I fall behind over something like this,
I'll stay a weakling forever...!
choice_data_list: You won't be able to run properly unless you rest.
You won't be able to run properly unless you rest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up, shut up!
Acting all high and mighty with your logical points...!!
choice_data_list: Still, you don't want lies or empty platitudes, right?
Still, you're not looking for lies or platitudes, are you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Of course not...!
I won't forgive you if you say that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it!
I'm definitely gonna recover fast...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, although it was mostly out of sulking, Narita Taishin did take some time to rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her still trying to stand up despite her injury moved me deeply.
When I told her I would support her with everything I had—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Fine, as long as you get it...
Though you really are suffocatingly intense.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, shut up already!
I told you to stop, you're distracting me—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ouuuch...gah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, Narita Taishin aggravated her injury during training and was forced to take time off to rest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not yet...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Good grief,
it's not like it's a ticket or anything...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Still, making noise dulls the pain,
and it definitely fires me up... Annoying as it is to admit――)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin showed her sheer grit and
managed to power through the rest of the day's training.
